text: This report summarizes the performance review of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Chief Executive Officer and provides a compensation recommendation.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Adopted the Confidential Instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 13, 2026) Report from the Chair, Human Resources Committee, from the Human Resources Committee with respect to Chief Executive Officer compensation. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 (April 13, 2026) Report from the Chair, Human Resources Committee, remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains personal matters about an identifiable person.
